method: Read the effective primary EC3 PDF captions, table cells, printed footers and overlay annotations; cross-checked current parsers, public host consumers, assertion bodies, durable parent-review records, selected ADRs and current ledger rows. No tests executed.
scope_correction: The exact source titles do not match a literal interpretation of the task's table numbers. Table 146 is 'Overprinting behaviour in the transparent imaging model' (§11.7), not a viewer-preferences table. Table 147 is 'Entries in a viewer preferences dictionary' (§12.2), and Table 148 is 'Names defined for an Enforce array'. PageLayout/PageMode are in catalog Table 29 (§7.7.2), not Tables 146–148. Tables 153 and 154 are 'Entries in a collection dictionary' and 'Entries in a collection schema dictionary'; article thread/bead definitions are Tables 162 and 163 in §12.4.3. Reviewed the actual related tables instead of assigning article or viewer rules to the wrong tables.

effective_errata.effect: Adds UseAttachments (PDF 2.0), so that value is supported in both catalog /PageMode (Table 29) and /NonFullScreenPageMode; FullScreen remains catalog-only.

cells.source: Optional. SinglePage, OneColumn, TwoColumnLeft/Right, TwoPageLeft/Right; default SinglePage. Catalog choice applies when opened.
cells.assertions: table_29s_display_entries_are_not_table_147 checks TwoPageRight and unknown-name fallback; current viewer-core layout/headless and viewer-host presentation assertions exercise actual page arrangements and opening.

cells.source: Optional. UseNone, UseOutlines, UseThumbs, FullScreen, UseOC, UseAttachments; default UseNone; applies when opened.
cells.implementation: Opening::in_catalog maps all six; viewer-host/src/presentation.rs maps page mode to panels/presentation; viewer-ui/chrome.rs supplies supported panels.
cells.assertions: table_29s_display_entries_are_not_table_147 includes UseAttachments and FullScreen; presentation tests cover opening, fullscreen exit and condition. ADR 0142/0143 records the chosen sidebar consumers; exact panel layout remains product UI.

cells.source: Table 29: destination/action at open; absent OpenAction opens first page at default magnification.
cells.implementation: viewer-core open/interact route, covered by viewer_preferences_layout_current and navigation/action shards.
cells.assertions: Durable viewer_preferences_layout_current parent-review confirms catalog OpenAction route and event order testing; no re-execution claimed here.

cells.keys: HideToolbar, HideMenubar, HideWindowUI, FitWindow, CenterWindow, DisplayDocTitle
cells.source: Optional booleans, each defaults false. Hide/display and sizing/placement apply when document is active; DisplayDocTitle uses XMP dc:title when true (should wording).
cells.implementation: pdf-model/src/viewer_preferences.rs stores all six; viewer-core Query::Preferences and host/native window consumers carry stated values.
cells.assertions: ViewerPreferences::table_147s_entries_are_read checks each true value; default test checks false. Durable viewer_preferences_layout_current review distinguishes GTK/Qt HideMenubar and positioning departures and avoids claiming all native window effects are uniform.

cells.source: Optional; UseNone/UseOutlines/UseThumbs/UseOC/UseAttachments after EC3 #275; default UseNone. SHALL be ignored unless catalog PageMode is FullScreen.
cells.implementation: ViewerPreferences::in_catalog accepts only this entry's value set; host Presenting uses it as exit mode only when opening mode is FullScreen.
cells.assertions: Model test checks UseOC, FullScreen is rejected as an entry value, UseAttachments is accepted by #275. viewer-host presentation test `the_page_mode_to_come_back_to_is_read_only_where_the_catalog_asked_for_full_screen` exercises catalog condition/ignored case.

cells.source: Optional, L2R/R2L; default L2R. No direct effect on contents or page numbering; may inform relative page positioning side-by-side/n-up.
cells.implementation: Parsed and handed through Query::Preferences; explicit PageLayout side/odd-page position remains its own rule.
cells.assertions: Table 147 parser fixture checks R2L. No source requirement to reorder content or override explicit layout; current UI choice is a qualified optional/policy boundary.

cells.source: Optional boundary names; defaults CropBox. First two select screen displayed/clipped region; latter two select print region/clipping. Deprecated in PDF 2.0 as producer entries, not a reader exemption.
cells.implementation: Page::display_box/clip_box for view entries, printing route for print entries.
cells.assertions: Parser fixture checks non-default boundary values; public geometry/print tests owned by page-boundary and print-scaling shards. ADR 0071 established pixel-affecting view support; not re-audited as a new defect here.

cells.source: PrintScaling None/AppDefault; unknown => AppDefault; default AppDefault and still honored when print dialog suppressed. Duplex choices Simplex/short-edge/long-edge, default implementation-dependent. PickTrayByPDFSize default implementation-dependent and OS-dependent effect. PrintPageRange 1-based inclusive pairs, default implementation-dependent. NumCopies default implementation-dependent, typically 1.
cells.implementation: Parsed and projected to viewer-host print plan; host printer/dialog policy remains separate from PDF reader values.
cells.assertions: Model table test checks individual values; targeted print policy/native assertions are in print-scaling and host print shards. Do not impose Simplex/false/1 as ISO defaults.

cells.source: Optional PDF 2.0 array; only names defined by Table 148 are permitted. Future additions constrained by non-DoS and non-overridable defaults.
cells.implementation: Only PrintScaling is represented; flag becomes enforced iff value is valid and not AppDefault.
cells.assertions: Model tests check valid NoScaling is enforceable and unrecognized /Shrink falls back to AppDefault and cannot be enforced; host policy tests and ADR 2840/parent review cover enforcement warning and UI capability limitations.

cells.source: Optional array of thread dictionaries; catalog Table 29 says indirect reference. Navigation facility for following thread is permitted, not a mandate for a specific UI.
cells.implementation: pdf-model/src/article.rs::Articles; Query::Articles; viewer-core and panel consumers.
cells.assertions: Exact-xref model ring tests and producer-document tests cover indexed threads, decoded I/title and closure; public UI and core thread-action tests cover the optional navigation route.

cells.source: F required indirect first bead. I optional document-information-style dictionary. Metadata optional PDF 2.0 indirect stream.
cells.implementation: Parser follows F ring; I/metadata data exposed where available.
cells.assertions: Current tests exercise F and I/title; no claim that every metadata stream property is certified in this pass.

cells.source: T is indirect thread reference, required on first bead and optionally on others (PDF-version wording retained); N and V are required indirect next/previous links closing the ring.
cells.implementation: Articles::read_thread starts at F and follows N, with repeat guard; V is not separately walked because it is the reverse-link consistency constraint.
cells.assertions: article.rs tests ring closure/wrap, mismatched page bead order and cycles; actual producer tests verify page links and public consumer tests activate a bead.

cells.source: P is required indirect page object; R is required rectangle in default user space locating bead on that page.
cells.implementation: Bead carries page and rectangle; viewer-core thread navigation applies R.
cells.assertions: headless `a_thread_action_shows_the_bead_and_not_merely_its_page` checks destination geometry, with public thread-action and panel consumers. Optional UI is not promoted to a SHALL.
